name: EmptyState

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.code:
<Box>
  <EmptyState
    icon="folder-open"
    title="No projects yet"
    description="Projects you create or join show up here."
  >
    <Button color="primary">New project</Button>
  </EmptyState>
</Box>

examples.title: More Than One Action
examples.code:
<Box>
  <EmptyState
    icon="folder-open"
    title="No projects yet"
    description="Projects you create or join show up here."
  >
    <EmptyState.Actions>
      <Button color="primary">New project</Button>
      <Button>Import</Button>
    </EmptyState.Actions>
  </EmptyState>
</Box>

examples.code: No favorites yet Star a project to keep it here. A few to start with: Apollo Gemini

accessibility:
- **The title is a heading:** it's always one, `h1` to `h6`, and `h2` by default. Pick the level
  under the heading of the list it stands in for: an `h2` on a page, an `h3` or an `h4` in a Card.
  `titleAs` sets it for the `title` prop and `as` sets it on `EmptyState.Title`, and nothing about
  the size changes it. The size comes from the EmptyState, so `EmptyState.Title` doesn't take
  `Title`'s `size`.
- **The picture is decoration:** the indicator has `aria-hidden="true"`, so everything in it is
  hidden, an `Icon` with an `ariaLabel` included. Say what it means in the title or the
  description.
- **No role and no live region:** an empty state is content, and the heading makes it findable. It
  doesn't announce itself, since it arrives already filled, would read its buttons along with it,
  and is gone when results come back. After a search or a filter, announce the result with a
  `role="status"` region that's in the page the whole time, beside the search field, as in
  [A Search With No Results](https://bestax.io/docs/api/components/emptystate#a-search-with-no-results). Primer's
  [loading pattern](https://primer.style/product/ui-patterns/loading/) describes the same thing.
- **Focus:** nothing in the component moves focus. A "Clear search" button goes away with the
  empty state, so its click handler puts focus back in the search field rather than leaving it on
  the page's `<body>`.
- **Not for loading or errors:** while the data loads, show a [`Skeleton`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/skeleton)
  or a [`Loader`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/loader), so "No projects yet" doesn't flash before the projects
  arrive. A load that failed is a [`Message`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/components/message) or a
  [`Notification`](https://bestax.io/docs/api/elements/notification).
- **Contrast:** the description is the color of the text around it, so it keeps the contrast its
  container has, a colored Hero included, and the title is Bulma's title color. The circle is
  decoration, so it doesn't owe a contrast ratio, but every pairing reads in light and dark mode.
- **Forced colors:** in Windows high contrast mode the icon takes the system's text color and
  stays visible. The circle's fill drops out, since it's decoration.
- **No motion:** nothing animates.
summary: The `EmptyState` component renders the block an app shows where content would be: an empty list, a search with no results, or a first-run screen. It's a column of a picture in a circle, a heading, a line of text and the actions, with one layout whether it's written with the `icon`, `title` and `description` props or with the parts. The children always render as written, after the parts the props render. It has no role and no live region. It arrives already filled and goes away when results come back, so it can't announce a search that matched nothing: keep a `role="status"` region beside the search field for that, in the page the whole time. While the data loads, show a `Skeleton` or a `Loader` instead, so "No projects yet" doesn't flash first, and show a load that failed in a `Message` or a `Notification`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: icon
props.description: The picture in the indicator's circle. A string is an `Icon` name, drawn from the icon library `ConfigProvider` sets. Anything else (an `` with its own `variant` or `library`, an SVG, an ``) renders as it is. It's decorative and hidden from assistive tech, so the title says what it means.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, rendered as `EmptyState.Title`. It's always a real heading, at the level `titleAs` sets.

props.name: titleAs
props.description: The heading level for `title`: the level under the heading of the list it stands in for, such as `h3` for a list under an `h2`. Only this sets the level, and the size comes from `size`.

props.name: description
props.description: A sentence or two under the title, rendered as `EmptyState.Description`.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered as written, after whatever `icon`, `title` and `description` render. One button can go straight in, and it sits centered under the text. Group two or more in `EmptyState.Actions`, or they stack. Without the props, write the parts here in the order they're shown: `EmptyState.Indicator`, `.Title`, `.Description`, then the actions.

props.name: color
props.description: The indicator's color. It colors the circle and its icon, not the text. Without it the circle is neutral, since an empty list isn't a status.

props.name: variant
props.description: `light` is a soft tint of `color` behind the icon in the color. `filled` is the color itself, with the icon in its invert.

props.name: size
props.description: Sizes the indicator, the title, the description and the spacing together.

props.name: align
props.description: `center` stacks everything in a centered column. `left` puts the indicator beside the text, at the start of the line, so on the right in a right-to-left page, and keeps the block at least as tall as the circle whatever block padding is in effect. Without an indicator, it only puts the text at the start of the line. In `left`, the padding at the start of the line is what makes room for the indicator, so pad it with `py` rather than `p` or `px`.
